newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CCC Information raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CCC Information raised.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said it upgraded CCC Information Services Group Inc to buy from outperform.
-- Cited strong fundamentals and recent share price weakness for upgrade.

-- Attributed 25 percent decline in share price since late January 1997 "to overall market weakness as well as concerns that additional CCC shares could come to market following the expiration of the IPO lockup provision last month."
